dataset_name: India Macroeconomic Context (RBI Policy Repo Rate)
source_name: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) - Monetary Policy Committee resolutions
source: RBI MPC policy statements. Each entry is (effective_date, repo_rate_%) taken verbatim from the published resolution; the monthly series is a forward-fill.
country_context: India - national monetary policy. The repo rate is the headline lending-rate anchor that flows into SME borrowing cost / EMI.
business_domain: Macroeconomic context for SME finance and demand analysis
license: RBI content is Government of India public information (attribution expected).
citation: Reserve Bank of India. Monetary Policy Committee resolutions, 2019-2025. https://www.rbi.org.in.
download_date: 2026-08-29 (repo-rate change points compiled from RBI MPC resolutions)
preprocessing: ml/preprocessing/india_macro_adapter.py: forward-fill repo rate from published change points; month-over-month change
known_limitations: Only the RBI policy repo rate is integrated. CPI, WPI, GDP growth, IIP, fuel price and exchange rate are available from MoSPI / data.gov.in but sit behind the same rate-limited public API as AGMARKNET - documented as PENDING, not fabricated.
Forward-filled monthly; intra-month changes are attributed to the month they take effect.
Context only - never joined into SME-private datasets in a way that blurs provenance.
paper_usage: Optional macro-context covariate for the Indian evaluation; label INDIA_PUBLIC_CONTEXT. Observational only - not evidence of causality.
